class.name: FlowGraphPlayback
class.brief_description: Walks a [FlowGraph] like a state machine.

method.name: advance
method.description: Continues from the waiting node through the exit its [method FlowNode._choose_exit] returns. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if no node is waiting.

method.name: advance_to_exit
method.description: Continues from the waiting node through its flow output [param port]. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if no node is waiting and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if the node has no such flow output.

method.name: choose
method.description: Continues from the waiting node through the exit at [param exit_index] of [method get_available_exits]. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] for a disabled exit.

method.name: emit_event
method.description: Emits [signal event_emitted]. Used by [FlowEmitEventNode] and by custom node types.

method.name: get_available_exits
method.description: Returns the ways to leave the current node, from [method FlowNode._get_available_exits]: by default one [FlowExit] per flow output. [member FlowExit.node_id] is filled with the connected node. Use it to build choice menus, then call [method choose].

method.name: get_current_graph
method.description: Returns the graph on top of the stack: the graph of a running subgraph, else the graph passed to [method start].

method.name: get_current_node
method.description: Returns the current node of [method get_current_graph], or [code]null[/code] when the playback does not play.

method.name: get_current_node_id
method.description: Returns the id of the current node in [method get_current_graph], or [code]-1[/code] when the playback does not play.

method.name: get_graph
method.description: Returns the graph passed to [method start] (or restored by [method set_state]). It stays set after the playback finished.

method.name: get_graph_stack_depth
method.description: Returns the number of graph levels: [code]1[/code] in the main graph, one more per running subgraph, [code]0[/code] when the playback does not play.

method.name: get_history
method.description: Returns the ids of the entered nodes since [method start], oldest first, on all graph levels. Only the last 256 entries are kept.

method.name: get_input_value
method.description: Returns the value of the data input [param port] of the node that is being entered, processed or evaluated. Call it from the runtime virtual methods of [FlowNode]. A connected input evaluates its source node; an unconnected input reads the port's default value.

method.name: get_node_input_value
method.description: Returns the value of the data input [param port] of the node [param node_id] in [method get_current_graph], at any time. For tools and debugging.

method.name: get_node_memory
method.description: Returns the runtime value that the node that is being entered, processed or evaluated stored with [method set_node_memory], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the current state: graph, node on every graph level, node memory, history, variables and the waiting flag. Save it with [ResourceSaver] and restore it with [method set_state].

method.name: get_travel_path
method.description: Returns the shortest flow path from the current node to [param to_id] in [method get_current_graph], both included, or an empty array.

method.name: get_variable
method.description: Returns the value of a variable of the [member blackboard], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_variable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the [member blackboard] has the variable.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] between [method start] and the end of the graph or [method stop].

method.name: is_waiting
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the current node waits ([constant ENTER_RESULT_WAIT]).

method.name: process
method.description: Calls [method FlowNode._process_waiting] of the waiting node and continues when it returns [code]true[/code]. Does nothing when no node waits through [method FlowNode._process_waiting]. [FlowGraphPlayer] calls it for you.

method.name: set_node_memory
method.description: Stores a runtime value for the node that is being entered, processed or evaluated, for example the elapsed time of a wait. Node memory belongs to the graph level and is part of [method get_state]; resources are shared between graphs, so keep runtime data here and not in node properties.

method.name: set_state
method.description: Restores a state from [method get_state]. The graph is loaded from [member FlowGraphState.graph_path] unless the playback already has it; a graph without a path (built in code) is restored onto the current graph, so call [method start] first. A waiting state emits [signal node_waiting] again; a state saved between two nodes enters the current node again.

method.name: set_variable
method.description: Sets a variable of the [member blackboard].

method.name: start
method.description: Starts [param graph] at [param from_id], or at [member FlowGraph.start_node_id] for [constant START_NODE_DEFAULT], and runs until a node waits or the graph ends. Declared variables that the [member blackboard] does not have yet are added with their default values; existing values are kept. The first start of a graph validates it and prints its issues as warnings. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] if the start node does not exist.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the playback and emits [signal stopped].

method.name: travel
method.description: Moves to the node [param to_id] of [method get_current_graph]. [constant TRAVEL_MODE_WALK] follows [method get_travel_path]: every node on the way is entered and exited (their effects run, waits are skipped, subgraphs are not entered); returns [constant ERR_CANT_RESOLVE] without a path. [constant TRAVEL_MODE_TELEPORT] leaves the current node and enters [param to_id] directly.

members.member: The variables of the playback. A new empty blackboard by default; share one between playbacks for common state (quests, dialogs). Setting [code]null[/code] creates a new empty one. [signal variable_changed] repeats its changes.
The deepest chain of data pulls (a node reading an input that reads an input ...). Deeper chains, usually data cycles, stop the playback with an error.
The most nodes entered in one call ([method start], [method advance], [method travel] ...). More, usually a flow loop without a waiting node, stops the playback with an error.
The most nested graph levels. More, usually a graph that contains itself, stops the playback with an error.

signal.name: event_emitted
signal.description: Emitted by a [FlowEmitEventNode] or by [method emit_event].

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when the main graph ends, with the id of the end node (or of the node whose flow output had no connection).

signal.name: node_entered
signal.description: Emitted when a node becomes the current node, before it runs.

signal.name: node_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the playback leaves a node.

signal.name: node_waiting
signal.description: Emitted when the current node waits, and by [method set_state] when it restores a waiting node. Show dialog lines or choices here.

signal.name: started
signal.description: Emitted by [method start] before the first node is entered.

signal.name: stopped
signal.description: Emitted by [method stop], also when a guard stopped the playback.

signal.name: variable_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a variable of the [member blackboard] changes, also when another playback changed a shared blackboard.

constants.constant: The node is done; the playback leaves it through [method FlowNode._choose_exit].
The node waits until [method advance], [method advance_to_exit], [method choose] or its [method FlowNode._process_waiting] continues.
The node ends its graph, like a [FlowEndNode].
Represents the size of the [enum EnterResult] enum.
Walk along the shortest flow path and run the nodes on the way.
Jump to the target node directly.
Represents the size of the [enum TravelMode] enum.
